item.description:
Thank you for using Levo!

This update brings:

  • Breakdown: a new layout in Settings › General that shows memory, CPU and GPU as bars. Hovering a gauge shows the same breakdown.
  • Levo finds more: creative apps, local AI models, browsers and moved caches.
  • Analysing shows each step.
  • Now you can switch agents.
  • Many more small improvements across the app.

Thank you for your feedback. Help improve Levo by reporting bugs and suggesting ideas from Settings › Send feedback.
